_real_world.class: Dual Band Radar (DBR): AN/SPY-3 (X-band MFR) + AN/SPY-4 (S-band VSR)
_real_world.variant_scope: CVN-78 Gerald R. Ford unique fit; CVN-79 and later replace this with AN/SPY-6(V)3 EASR.

_provenance.modeling_note: Single combined Sensor module standing in for the Ford's two-radar Dual Band Radar suite (SPY-3 X-band MFR for horizon-search/illumination-support roles, SPY-4 S-band VSR for long-range volume search); the engine has one Radar sensor slot per mount so the two are merged into one instrumented-range proxy rather than split into separate records. No public detection range exists for DBR (DOT&E FY25 calls performance/sustainment a risk area without publishing numbers); range is an engineering estimate from the S-band volume-search planning band the OOB page gives (150-250 nmi) combined with the 40 m antenna_height_m mast estimate, biased toward the top of that band because DBR is a newer, larger-aperture system than SPY-1. Since Geodetic Frame P3-A the runtime's smooth-earth horizon binds first against low targets regardless of this instrumented value.

sensor.type.note: Dual Band Radar is a radar suite; Radar is the only matching engine sensor type for the merged SPY-3/SPY-4 proxy

sensor.max_range.note: R8: DBR detection range is not public; 250 nmi (top of the OOB's 150-250 nmi S-band planning band) -> 296300 m, biased up for a larger phased array than SPY-1

sensor.fov_deg.note: DBR is a fixed-face phased array suite giving full 360-deg coverage across faces, consistent with how the merged single-sensor proxy is modeled

sensor.scan_period.note: no public scan-rate figure; carried unchanged from the repo's existing AN/SPY-1D_Volume_Search_MVP calibration as the nearest available phased-array search radar baseline

sensor.detection_prob.note: no public Pd figure; engineering estimate slightly above the SPY-1D MVP baseline, reflecting DBR's newer/larger aperture, magnitude not calibrated to a source

sensor.bearing_noise_std.note: no public bearing-accuracy figure; engineering estimate scaled down (better accuracy) from the SPY-1D MVP baseline for a newer AESA-derived array

sensor.range_noise_std.note: no public range-accuracy figure; engineering estimate scaled down from the SPY-1D MVP baseline, same reasoning as bearing_noise_std

sensor.track_memory_s.note: no public track-coast figure; engineering estimate slightly above the SPY-1D MVP baseline

sensor.range_power.note: radar-equation exponent (inverse-4th-power family); standard engine default for a search radar, not sourced per-platform

sensor.aspect_influence.note: 0.0 disables RCS aspect-angle modeling, consistent with the repo's other naval radar records' simplified detection model

sensor.doppler_notch_width.note: no public MTI/doppler-notch figure; carried unchanged from repo SPY-1D MVP calibration

sensor.reference_snr_db.note: radar-equation calibration constant paired with reference_range_m/reference_rcs_m2 to reproduce this record's max_range at a reference target; not independently sourced

sensor.reference_range_m.note: paired radar-equation calibration constant, see reference_snr_db

sensor.reference_rcs_m2.note: 5 m^2 generic warship/large-aircraft reference RCS, engine convention also used across the repo's other naval radar records

sensor.antenna_height_m.note: no public mast height; scaled from CVN78's larger island vs Nimitz-class proxy mast heights

sensor.target_height_bias_m.note: no public figure; engineering estimate lower than the SPY-1D MVP's 25 m bias, since DBR's taller island mast already contributes more of the horizon-geometry advantage via antenna_height_m

sensor.environment_domain.note: surface/maritime domain selected for a carrier's primary search radar per authoring standard

sensor.sea_clutter_enabled.note: disabled, consistent with the repo's other naval radar records' simplified detection model; no sourced clutter-suppression figure exists to calibrate an enabled model

sensor.enable_ducting.note: standard engine atmospheric-ducting toggle, enabled consistent with the repo's other long-range naval search radar records

sensor.ducting_gain_factor.note: carried unchanged from repo SPY-1D MVP calibration

sensor.ducting_max_bonus_m.note: scaled up slightly from repo SPY-1D MVP calibration proportional to this record's larger max_range
